steps.instruction:
step 1
Put a sieve over a large bowl, line it with a thick sheet of non-dyed kitchen paper or a clean muslin cloth, and spoon in the yogurt

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Cover with another sheet of kitchen paper and leave to strain in the fridge for a minimum of 12 hrs

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction:
step 2
Add the lemon juice, most of the olive oil and the dried mint to a bowl and stir well for the dried mint to soften and soak up the juices

steps.instruction: Mix in the strained yogurt, then pour away the strained yogurt liquid and leave that bowl to one side

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction:
step 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Using clean hands (or a clean muslin cloth), squeeze as much of the liquid out of the cucumber as possible

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction:
step 4
Add the strained, grated cucumber, garlic and ¾ tsp flaky salt to the rest of the ingredients and mix well

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Garnish with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkling of dried mint

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Pick through your lentils for any foreign debris, rinse them 2 or 3 times, drain, and set aside

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction:
Fair warning, this will probably turn your lentils into a solid block that you’ll have to break up later
In a large pot over medium-high heat, sauté the olive oil and the onion with a pinch of salt for about 3 minutes, then add the carrots and cook for another 3 minutes

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add the tomato paste and stir it around for around 1 minute

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Now add the cumin, paprika, mint, thyme, black pepper, and red pepper as quickly as you can and stir for 10 seconds to bloom the spices

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Congratulate yourself on how amazing your house now smells

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Immediately add the lentils, water, broth, and salt

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Bring the soup to a (gentle) boil

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: After it has come to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, cover the pot halfway, and cook for 15-20 minutes or until the lentils have fallen apart and the carrots are completely cooked

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: After the soup has cooked and the lentils are tender, blend the soup either in a blender or simply use a hand blender to reach the consistency you desire

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Taste for seasoning and add more salt if necessary

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Serve with crushed-up crackers, torn up bread, or something else to add some extra thickness

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: You could also use a traditional thickener (like cornstarch or flour), but I prefer to add crackers for some texture and saltiness

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: Makes great leftovers, stays good in the fridge for about a week

steps.instruction: Season the Meat: Generously salt the beef cuts

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction:
STEP 1
TO MAKE SUSHI ROLLS: Pat out some rice

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Lay a nori sheet on the mat, shiny-side down

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Dip your hands in the vinegared water, then pat handfuls of rice on top in a 1cm thick layer, leaving the furthest edge from you clear

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction:
STEP 2
Spread over some Japanese mayonnaise

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Use a spoon to spread out a thin layer of mayonnaise down the middle of the rice

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction:
STEP 3
Add the filling

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Get your child to top the mayonnaise with a line of their favourite fillings – here we’ve used tuna and cucumber

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction:
STEP 4
Roll it up

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Lift the edge of the mat over the rice, applying a little pressure to keep everything in a tight roll

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction:
STEP 5
Stick down the sides like a stamp

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: When you get to the edge without any rice, brush with a little water and continue to roll into a tight roll

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction:
STEP 6
Wrap in cling film

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: Remove the mat and roll tightly in cling film before a grown-up cuts the sushi into thick slices, then unravel the cling film

steps.title: Step 14
steps.instruction:
STEP 7
TO MAKE PRESSED SUSHI: Layer over some smoked salmon

steps.title: Step 15
steps.instruction: Line a loaf tin with cling film, then place a thin layer of smoked salmon inside on top of the cling film

steps.title: Step 16
steps.instruction:
STEP 8
Cover with rice and press down

steps.title: Step 17
steps.instruction: Press about 3cm of rice over the fish, fold the cling film over and press down as much as you can, using another tin if you have one

steps.title: Step 18
steps.instruction:
STEP 9
Tip it out like a sandcastle

steps.title: Step 19
steps.instruction: Turn block of sushi onto a chopping board

steps.title: Step 20
steps.instruction: Get a grown-up to cut into fingers, then remove the cling film

steps.title: Step 21
steps.instruction:
STEP 10
TO MAKE SUSHI BALLS: Choose your topping

steps.title: Step 22
steps.instruction: Get a small square of cling film and place a topping, like half a prawn or a small piece of smoked salmon, on it

steps.title: Step 23
steps.instruction: Use damp hands to roll walnut-sized balls of rice and place on the topping

steps.title: Step 24
steps.instruction:
STEP 11
Make into tight balls

steps.title: Step 25
steps.instruction: Bring the corners of the cling film together and tighten into balls by twisting it up, then unwrap and serve

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Cover with another sheet of kitchen paper and leave to strain in the fridge for a minimum of 12 hrs

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction:
step 2
Add the lemon juice, most of the olive oil and the dried mint to a bowl and stir well for the dried mint to soften and soak up the juices

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction:
step 3
Halve the cucumber(s) lengthways and remove the seeds by running a teaspoon from the top to the bottom of the flesh, halve the cucumbers widthways to make them shorter and easier to handle, then coarsely grate each one into the bowl the yogurt was straining over

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Using clean hands (or a clean muslin cloth), squeeze as much of the liquid out of the cucumber as possible

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction:
step 4
Add the strained, grated cucumber, garlic and ¾ tsp flaky salt to the rest of the ingredients and mix well

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Garnish with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkling of dried mint

quick.title: Corba

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Pick through your lentils for any foreign debris, rinse them 2 or 3 times, drain, and set aside

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction:
Fair warning, this will probably turn your lentils into a solid block that you’ll have to break up later
In a large pot over medium-high heat, sauté the olive oil and the onion with a pinch of salt for about 3 minutes, then add the carrots and cook for another 3 minutes

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add the tomato paste and stir it around for around 1 minute

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Now add the cumin, paprika, mint, thyme, black pepper, and red pepper as quickly as you can and stir for 10 seconds to bloom the spices

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Congratulate yourself on how amazing your house now smells

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Immediately add the lentils, water, broth, and salt

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Bring the soup to a (gentle) boil

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: After it has come to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, cover the pot halfway, and cook for 15-20 minutes or until the lentils have fallen apart and the carrots are completely cooked

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: After the soup has cooked and the lentils are tender, blend the soup either in a blender or simply use a hand blender to reach the consistency you desire

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Taste for seasoning and add more salt if necessary

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Serve with crushed-up crackers, torn up bread, or something else to add some extra thickness

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: You could also use a traditional thickener (like cornstarch or flour), but I prefer to add crackers for some texture and saltiness

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: Makes great leftovers, stays good in the fridge for about a week
